notes: Rules classify upstream Canvas WPT areas that are outside the current implementation.
Official smoke tests live in tests/wpt/canvas-smoke-tests.txt and are executed by npm run test:wpt.

rules.reason: Depends on HTMLCanvasElement attributes, parser reflection, layout, fallback content, or DOM host behavior outside createCanvas().
Depends on OffscreenCanvas and worker host behavior.
Depends on HTML media/image loading host behavior.
Path construction, fill, stroke, clipping, and hit testing are not implemented yet.
Path2D is not implemented yet.
Only scale(), rotate(), translate(), transform(), setTransform(), resetTransform(), and getTransform() basics exist; broader transform edge cases are not implemented yet.
Stroke state and line styling are not implemented yet.
Text styles and font parsing are not implemented yet.
Text drawing and text metrics are not implemented yet.
drawImage() and CanvasImageSource handling are not implemented yet.
globalAlpha and globalCompositeOperation are not implemented yet.
Shadow state and rendering are not implemented yet.
Canvas filters are not implemented yet.
Only a small fillStyle color subset exists; gradients, patterns, strokeStyle, and broad CSS color parsing are not implemented yet.
Only getImageData() basics exist; createImageData(), putImageData(), color spaces, and settings are not implemented yet.
Only fillRect()/clearRect() basics exist; strokeRect(), state interaction, transforms, shadows, and edge cases are not implemented yet.
save(), restore(), reset(), and drawing state stacks are not implemented yet.
Image smoothing state is not implemented yet.
Canvas color space and color type options are not implemented yet.
Canvas color type options are not implemented yet.
